/-- Fifth logarithmic jet of the complete theta source in first-atom/source coordinates. -/
def thetaCuspFullLogJetFive (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -thetaCuspBornWittenLogFifthDerivative 1 x +
    thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFive x

/-- Sixth logarithmic jet of the complete theta source in first-atom/source coordinates. -/
def thetaCuspFullLogJetSix (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -thetaCuspBornWittenLogSixthDerivative 1 x +
    thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetSix x

/-- Exact fifth logarithmic derivative of the actual complete theta source. -/
theorem iteratedDeriv_five_thetaCuspLogSource_eq_full_jets
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    iteratedDeriv 5 thetaCuspLogSource x = thetaCuspFullLogJetFive x := by
  have heq : iteratedDeriv 4 thetaCuspLogSource =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun y : ℝ =>
        -thetaCuspBornWittenLogFourthDerivative 1 y +
          thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFour y) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    rw [iteratedDeriv_four_thetaCuspLogSource_eq_factor hy,
      thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFour_eq_higherLikelihoodLogJetFour hy]
  have hfirst :=
    (hasDerivAt_thetaCuspBornWittenLogFourthDerivative
      (n := 1) (by norm_num) hx.le).neg
  have hhigher := hasDerivAt_thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFour
    (thetaCuspLikelihoodCoordinate_pos hx.le)
  rw [show 5 = 4 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ]
  exact ((hfirst.add hhigher).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq).deriv

/-- Exact sixth logarithmic derivative of the actual complete theta source. -/
theorem iteratedDeriv_six_thetaCuspLogSource_eq_full_jets
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    iteratedDeriv 6 thetaCuspLogSource x = thetaCuspFullLogJetSix x := by
  have heq : iteratedDeriv 5 thetaCuspLogSource =ᶠ[nhds x]
      thetaCuspFullLogJetFive := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact iteratedDeriv_five_thetaCuspLogSource_eq_full_jets hy
  have hfirst :=
    (hasDerivAt_thetaCuspBornWittenLogFifthDerivative
      (n := 1) (by norm_num) hx.le).neg
  have hhigher := hasDerivAt_thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFive
    (thetaCuspLikelihoodCoordinate_pos hx.le)
  have hfull : HasDerivAt thetaCuspFullLogJetFive
      (thetaCuspFullLogJetSix x) x := by
    unfold thetaCuspFullLogJetFive thetaCuspFullLogJetSix
    exact hfirst.add hhigher
  rw [show 6 = 5 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ]
  exact (hfull.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq).deriv

  thetaCuspBornWittenLogCurvature 1 x -

/-- Positive-coordinate form of the actual fourth logarithmic source jet. -/

  thetaCuspBornWittenLogFourthDerivative 1 x -
    thetaCuspLikelihoodSourceLogPartitionJetFour x

/-- Positive-coordinate form of the actual sixth logarithmic source jet. -/

  thetaCuspBornWittenLogSixthDerivative 1 x -

/-- Literal order-six reflected Hankel source polynomial for the complete theta source. -/

  let A := thetaCuspFullReflectedLogCurvature x
  let B := thetaCuspFullReflectedLogFourthJet x

curvature. -/

/-- Two-sided ideal generated by the Weyl relation. -/
def weylIdeal : TwoSidedIdeal PresentedWeyl :=
  TwoSidedIdeal.span {weylRelation}

def weylCongruence : RingCon PresentedWeyl := weylIdeal.ringCon

private lemma map_mem_weylIdeal
    (e : PresentedWeyl ≃+* PresentedWeyl) (he : e weylRelation = weylRelation)
    {a : PresentedWeyl} (ha : a ∈ weylIdeal) : e a ∈ weylIdeal := by
  apply TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction (s := {weylRelation})
      (p := fun a _ => e a ∈ weylIdeal) (x := a) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · intro z hz
    have hz' : z = weylRelation := by simpa using hz
    subst z
    rw [he]
    exact TwoSidedIdeal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton weylRelation)
  · rw [map_zero]
    exact weylIdeal.zero_mem
  · intro u v hu hv ihu ihv
    simpa using weylIdeal.add_mem ihu ihv
  · intro u hu ihu
    simpa using weylIdeal.neg_mem ihu
  · intro u v hv ihv
    simpa using weylIdeal.mul_mem_left (e u) (e v) ihv
  · intro v u hv ihv
    rw [map_mul]
    exact weylIdeal.mul_mem_right (e u) (e v) ihv

    fourierWord a ∈ weylIdeal ↔ a ∈ weylIdeal := by

  · intro ha
    have hInverseRelation : fourierWord.symm weylRelation = weylRelation := by
      apply fourierWord.injective
      simp [fourierWord_weylRelation]
    simpa using map_mem_weylIdeal fourierWord.symm.toRingEquiv hInverseRelation ha
  · exact map_mem_weylIdeal fourierWord.toRingEquiv fourierWord_weylRelation

    weylCongruence = weylCongruence.comap fourierWord.toRingEquiv := by
  apply RingCon.ext
  intro a b
  change weylIdeal.ringCon a b ↔
    weylIdeal.ringCon (fourierWord a) (fourierWord b)
  rw [TwoSidedIdeal.rel_iff, TwoSidedIdeal.rel_iff]
  rw [← map_sub, fourierWord_mem_weylIdeal_iff]

private lemma operatorSemantics_eq_zero_of_mem_weylIdeal
    {a : PresentedWeyl} (ha : a ∈ weylIdeal) : operatorSemantics a = 0 := by
  apply TwoSidedIdeal.span_induction (s := {weylRelation})
      (p := fun a _ => operatorSemantics a = 0) (x := a) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · intro z hz
    have hz' : z = weylRelation := by simpa using hz
    subst z
    simp [weylRelation, operatorSemantics_commutator]
  · exact map_zero operatorSemantics
  · intro u v hu hv ihu ihv
    simp [ihu, ihv]
  · intro u hu ihu
    simp [ihu]
  · intro u v hv ihv
    simp [map_mul, ihv]
  · intro v u hv ihv
    simp [map_mul, ihv]

  rw [RingCon.ker_apply]
  have hsub : a - b ∈ weylIdeal :=
    (TwoSidedIdeal.rel_iff weylIdeal a b).mp hab
  have hzero := operatorSemantics_eq_zero_of_mem_weylIdeal hsub
  rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hzero
  exact hzero

/-!
# The exact Fourier equation behind the Hedenmalm theta eigenfunction

The normalized theta-cusp Schwartz source has Fourier transform `XiC` on the real axis. For every
centered Xi zero `alpha`, the removable entire quotient `xiThetaEigenFourier alpha` solves

`(alpha - z) U(z) = -I * XiC z`.

It is the unique continuous solution of that equation on the whole complex plane. Thus the
vectors used in the Hedenmalm eigenbasis and completion files are the unique regular Fourier-side
solutions of the concrete theta-source equation, rather than an abstract family of divided
differences.
-/

open Complex Real MeasureTheory Set Filter Topology
open scoped FourierTransform SchwartzMap

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower

/-- The removable Hedenmalm quotient is continuous on the whole complex plane. -/
theorem continuous_xiThetaEigenFourier (alpha : ℂ) :
    Continuous (xiThetaEigenFourier alpha) := by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro z
  exact (xiThetaEigenFourier_analytic alpha z (Set.mem_univ z)).continuousAt

/-- The removable quotient as a continuous complex function. -/
def xiThetaEigenFourierContinuous (alpha : ℂ) : C(ℂ, ℂ) :=
  ⟨xiThetaEigenFourier alpha, continuous_xiThetaEigenFourier alpha⟩

/-- Continuous solutions of the transformed theta-source equation at spectral parameter
`alpha`. -/
def xiThetaFourierSolutionSet (alpha : ℂ) : Set C(ℂ, ℂ) :=
  {U | ∀ z : ℂ, (alpha - z) * U z = -I * XiC z}

/-- The removable quotient satisfies the transformed equation at every complex frequency,
including the removed point. -/
theorem xiThetaEigenFourier_equation
    {alpha : ℂ} (halpha : XiC alpha = 0) (z : ℂ) :
    (alpha - z) * xiThetaEigenFourier alpha z = -I * XiC z := by
  rw [xiThetaEigenFourier]
  have hfactor := sub_smul_dslope XiC alpha z
  rw [halpha, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at hfactor
  calc
    (alpha - z) * (I * dslope XiC alpha z) =
        -I * ((z - alpha) * dslope XiC alpha z) := by ring
    _ = -I * XiC z := by rw [hfactor]

/-- Exact regular-solution law: at a centered Xi zero, the continuous solution set of the
transformed Hedenmalm equation is the singleton containing the removable quotient. -/
theorem xiThetaFourierSolutionSet_eq_singleton
    {alpha : ℂ} (halpha : XiC alpha = 0) :
    xiThetaFourierSolutionSet alpha = {xiThetaEigenFourierContinuous alpha} := by
  ext U
  constructor
  · intro hU
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    have hfun : (U : ℂ → ℂ) = xiThetaEigenFourier alpha := by
      apply Continuous.ext_on (dense_compl_singleton alpha)
        U.continuous (continuous_xiThetaEigenFourier alpha)
      intro z hz
      have hne : z ≠ alpha := by
        simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hz
      have hcoef : alpha - z ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne.symm
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hcoef
      exact (hU z).trans (xiThetaEigenFourier_equation halpha z).symm
    exact congrFun hfun
  · intro hU
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hU
    subst U
    exact xiThetaEigenFourier_equation halpha

/-- On the real frequency axis the equation is driven by the Fourier transform of the concrete
theta-cusp Schwartz source. -/
theorem xiThetaEigenFourier_real_source_equation
    {alpha : ℂ} (halpha : XiC alpha = 0) (t : ℝ) :
    (alpha - (t : ℂ)) * xiThetaEigenFourier alpha (t : ℂ) =
      -I * (𝓕 xiThetaSchwartzSource) t := by
  rw [fourier_xiThetaSchwartzSource]
  exact xiThetaEigenFourier_equation halpha (t : ℂ)

end RHTower
